description: Search live residential rental listings across the US & Canada by ZIP code or city/state to benchmark market rent comps, rent per sq.ft, unit specs, pet/building flags, and leasing contacts. Cost: 2 Credits / rental listing returned (0 Credits if empty).

location.description: 5-digit US ZIP code (e.g. "78701") or City, State (e.g. "Austin, TX").

name: search_rental_listings

code.description: Status code (0 for success, -1 for error).

data.description: Normalized MLS listing search results and pagination totals.

count.description: Number of properties returned in this response.

listing_status.description: Normalized listing status (for_sale, for_rent, or sold).

location.description: Queried ZIP code or city/state location.

properties.description: Normalized property listings with price, AVM valuation, instant equity, rent estimate, gross cap rate, specs, address, photos, and agent.

total_available.description: Estimated total matching listings in the market.

meta.description: Request execution metadata including request ID, credits charged, cache status, and latency.

cached.description: Whether the response was served from the 6-hour write-through cache.

credits_charged.description: Credits deducted for this call (0 on empty or error).

request_id.description: Unique UUID identifying this API request.

took_ms.description: Total gateway execution time in milliseconds.

title: Search US & Canada For-Rent Apartments & Single-Family Rentals
